alerts_addressed: S3 pqtf_no_multileg (0 multi-leg out of 36 bets)
rca: Engine multi-leg branch stored positions with `legs_spec` but no `option_type`/`strike` keys. Analytics writer (scripts/audit/tf_analytics.py) read those keys directly and emitted `type=null, strike=0` per_bet rows. n_multi_leg counter was a no-op (commented `pass`). PQTF prompt also never loaded overrides.json (no _load_prompt_override helper) so the multi-leg-mandatory + zombie-rejection rules already published in data/prompts/overrides.json never reached the agents.

fixes.change: Add _load_prompt_override(fleet='pqtf') helper (mirrors POL TF). Inject override block into build_prompt() output. Multi-leg position dict now carries explicit option_type=strategy_kind + representative strike (short-strike for vertical/iron_condor, ATM for straddle/butterfly) + entry_price=abs(strat_cost). Net result: downstream consumers never see type=null/strike=0 again.

analyze_pqtf() detects multi-leg via pos.get('multi_leg') OR pos.get('strategy') in {vertical,iron_condor,straddle,butterfly}; increments per_agent[tid]['n_multi_leg'] and per_etf[etf]['multi_leg']; falls back to abs(cost)/(qty*100) for entry_price when missing so notional is non-zero on legacy rows.

tests_run: TEST 1: _load_prompt_override('pqtf') returns 638-char block with multi-leg + zombie rules
TEST 2: build_prompt() output contains 'PROMPT MUTATOR OVERRIDE' marker
TEST 3: analyze_pqtf() with mixed payload — n_multi_leg=1 for new vertical, n_multi_leg=1 for legacy iron_condor, no per_bet row has type=None
TEST 4: end-to-end run_session() with fake LLM returning vertical → 6/6 multi-leg positions all carry explicit type='vertical', strike>0, entry_price>0
